author: GitHub Copilot (AI modelling agent) for the Bronze Bohemia project

Python 3 + numpy (independent GLB parser, contact check)
origin: floor centre of the house footprint (terrain line y=0), root transforms identity

models.role: complete house: Wall, Frame, Roof, DoorRecess mesh nodes (HOUSE-001 split) + anchor nodes; the Roof node is separable (hide it for the roof-off/interior state).

export_bounds_m.note: incl. roof overhang/verge (~10.8 x 6.3 m envelope); walls are 10.0 x 5.5 m outer, eave 2.2 m, ridge 4.6 m

door_inside.use: extra: ground point just inside the threshold (0,0,2.2) for path-finding through the door

entry.use: ground point outside the centred +Z door, under the eave (roof underside 1.96 m above it); identity rotation like HOUSE-001 entry

hearth_spot.use: floor point (-3.4,0,0), yaw 0: KILN-001 hearth_base origin; KILN's own anchors (fire_center, pot_rest, firewood_spot, tend_origin) stay valid at yaw 0 and were measured clear of posts and walls

interior_center.use: floor centre (0,0,0), free floor between the two internal ridge posts at x = +-1.75

store_spot_1.use: floor point (1.2,0,-1.75), yaw 180: STORE-001 jar origin along the back wall; yaw 180 turns STORE worker_origin (local -Z) into the room

store_spot_3.use: floor point (4.3,0,-1.75), yaw 180 (as store_spot_1); spacing 1.55 m keeps STORE lid_rest clear of the neighbouring jar/renewed pit

states.note: Godot-instantiated visible totals; 'dressed' adds read-only KILN-001/POT-001/STORE-001 fixtures (not part of this kit) and excludes PERSON

door.note: clear opening inside the DoorRecess lining; a 1.70 m PERSON must stoop through a 1.50 m door (brief value, R)

reference_ids: K22 (Kuna et al. 2022, J. Anthropol. Archaeol. 67:101433, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: link/cite only)
HOUSE-001 r001 WH01-WH07 (inspiration only, inherited material language)

parts_and_uncertainties.part: footprint 10.0 x 5.5 m, eave 2.2 m, ridge 4.6 m, overhang 0.4 m
parts_and_uncertainties.note: brief design values for scale testing. The 5-8 m width is Kuna et al. 2022's assumption for unobserved regional houses (S-KU22 p.8), not a Brezince measurement; no house length, plan or post-hole layout is known for Brezince.

parts_and_uncertainties.part: ridge along X, door centred in the +Z long (eave) wall, 0.80 x 1.50 m clear
parts_and_uncertainties.note: brief; door position undocumented at Brezince. A 1.70 m PERSON must stoop (door head 1.50 m; contact preview shows the head above the lintel line). No second/gable door modelled (optional in brief).

parts_and_uncertainties.part: internal ridge-supporting posts at x = +-1.75 m + gable centre posts; bays 3.25/3.5/3.25 m
parts_and_uncertainties.note: invented layout for a single open room; tie beams at the internal posts and gables. Visible with the Roof node hidden.

parts_and_uncertainties.part: wattle-and-daub wall 0.18 m, ochre clay, darker 0.3 m foot band; timber; thatch with turf ridge
parts_and_uncertainties.note: HOUSE-001 r001 material language reused (same palette and recipe, new seed); roof covering/pitch not established for Bohemia
placement suggestions for fixtures only. Sunken storage vessels ~mid-house (S-KU22 p.8) is a site pattern; exact positions are F. The hearth/oven function of KILN-001 features is itself unproven.

parts_and_uncertainties.part: floor, door leaf, partitions, smoke hole, furnishings
parts_and_uncertainties.note: no floor mesh (terrain shows through, sunken STORE jars need a terrain cut by the game); no door leaf

deviations: Single kit GLB models/house_002.glb with a separable Roof node (as HOUSE-001) rather than separate roof/shell GLBs; roof-off = hide node 'Roof'.
Extra anchor door_inside (not in the brief list).
Daub texture tile 5 m (HOUSE-001: 4 m) so the 4.27 m gable apex never wraps the foot band; band kept at 0.30 m.
STORE-001 fixture read from an unmerged branch; KILN-001 used as merged provisional data.
Godot default import settings (incl. generate_lods=true, create_shadow_meshes=true); no animation in this GLB.
